metadata.source: State of New Jersey Local Finance Board & West Milford Township Audits

controversies.title: Ratable Base Balance & Assessment Equalization (West Milford Township)
controversies.entityInvolved: West Milford Township Governing Body & Tax Assessor
controversies.summary: Encompasses 80 square miles in the Highlands water protection zone. With 92.4% residential ratables and minimal commercial base, single-family homeowners bear nearly the entire school and municipal levy.
controversies.investigationDetails: Annual watchdog audit of municipal tax appeal exposure, commercial assessment accuracy, and county equalized tax distribution.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Homeowners bear 92.4% of all property taxes raised in West Milford Township.
controversies.status: Monitored Under NJ DLGS & County Tax Board Guidelines

controversies.title: Public School District Budget Growth & S2 State Aid Adjustments
controversies.entityInvolved: West Milford Township Board of Education
controversies.summary: Public education appropriations represent 56.1% of the composite property tax levy in West Milford Township.
controversies.investigationDetails: Watchdog analysis of per-pupil spending ($22,100/student) and health benefit premium cost-sharing under Chapter 44.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Annual school tax increases are capped at 2% under statutory levy limits unless statutory health care or enrollment adjustments apply.
controversies.status: Under Annual State DOE User-Friendly Budget Review

controversies.title: Commercial Development Tax Abatements (PILOT Shift)
controversies.entityInvolved: West Milford Township Municipal Redevelopment Agency
controversies.summary: Commercial PILOT agreements in West Milford Township yield $271,369 in service fees while abating standard property taxes.
controversies.investigationDetails: Under NJ Long-Term Tax Exemption Law, municipal government retains 95% of PILOT revenues, leaving local school districts with 0% of payments.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Shifts an estimated $20.18 per homeowner annually in indirect education funding burden.
